'''Curtains''' were pieces of cloth used to block the view of a stage from the crowd during a performance.<ref name="QOTE">''[[Queen of the Empire]]''</ref>

Smaller curtains were also used in sentients' homes, to cover [[Window/Legends|windows]] and stop people looking into their homes. During [[riot]]s people often drew their curtains so as not to view the bloodshed.<ref name="Cod">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> The curtains were often drawn tight in hotels, so that the inside of the rooms&mdash;which were often grubby or unkempt&mdash;were not visible to potential customers.<ref name="IJ">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref> The color of curtains varied, though deep blue curtains were in existence on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belazura]].<ref name="jq">''[[Jedi Quest: The Moment of Truth]]''</ref> There was a certain type of curtains which were transparent during the day but opaque after dark.<ref name="s">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> On the planet [[Ambria/Legends|Ambria]], [[Caleb]] used a thin curtain to cover over his front door.<ref name="PoD">''[[Darth Bane: Path of Destruction]]''</ref>

[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were one [[Species/Legends|species]] known to utilize curtains, and they did so on their homeworld of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="HttE">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> The inhabitants of [[Ord Cestus/Legends|Ord Cestus]] also used curtains.<ref name="cd">''[[The Cestus Deception]]''</ref> [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had curtains in his [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|palace]] which he used to hide himself and his court to surprise [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi junior novelization">[[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi (junior novelization)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novel]]</ref> Curtains were also used by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] in their [[Koros-Strohna|worldships]], though these were presumably organic.<ref name="aoc">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos I: Hero's Trial]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Curtains were first named in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s ''[[Heir to the Empire]]'', but have also appeared in numerous other ''[[Star Wars]]'' works.

The word "curtain" is commonly used by ''Star Wars'' authors in metaphors and similes, but these are probably not in-universe appearances of curtains.<ref name="Cod" /><ref name="TG">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref><ref name="uq">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref><ref name="tempest">''[[Legacy of the Force: Tempest]]''</ref><ref name="dn1">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
